title: Stage 3A pooled Brier comparison
alt_text: Two-panel chart comparing held-out Brier scores and the paired bootstrap improvement. Projected Omega_A improves on the strongest simple baseline, but this alone does not satisfy all preregistered criteria.

title: Stage 3A block and transfer-stratum improvements
alt_text: Horizontal bar chart of Stage 3A Brier improvements by block and transfer stratum. All five blocks are positive, while the 1.25 capacity multiplier is slightly negative.

title: Stage 3A held-out reliability
alt_text: Reliability diagram for projected Omega_A and the strongest simple baseline on 21,600 held-out rows. The candidate calibration slope is 0.454, below the preregistered range.

title: Stage 3B final-size MAE comparison
alt_text: Two-panel chart comparing final-size MAE for phase-separated DMP and the calibration-selected temporal propagator, plus the paired bootstrap improvement interval crossing zero.

title: Stage 3B outbreak Brier comparison
alt_text: Two-panel chart showing nearly equal outbreak Brier scores and a paired bootstrap improvement interval crossing zero and far below the ten percent gate.

title: Stage 3B transfer and calibration-shift results
alt_text: Two-panel chart showing final-size transfer improvement by unseen scale and topology, and calibration-slope changes under defense and segmentation shifts. N equals 10,000, Barabasi-Albert, and detection response fail their rules.
